Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Verify the complete end-to-end learning journey through the actual UI: sequential Lesson unlocking
column8: and the access-boundary guards around Lesson content.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: A freshly enrolled Learner can open Lesson 1 while later Lessons stay locked.
column3: 1. Log in as a Learner freshly enrolled in a multi-lesson course. 2. Open the course's syllabus. 3. Tap Lesson 1, then check Lesson 2/3.
column4: Lesson 1 opens and its content renders; Lesson 2 and later show a locked indicator and are not directly openable.
column5: Learner freshly enrolled, no lessons completed yet.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Completing Lesson 1 unlocks and auto-navigates to Lesson 2.
column4: A `lesson_progresses` completion record is created for Lesson 1; the app auto-navigates to Lesson 2; Lesson 2 is now openable from the syllabus.
column5: Learner is on Lesson 1, not yet completed.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Deep-linking directly to a Lesson two steps ahead of the Learner's actual progress is blocked.
column3: 1. As a Learner who has completed only Lesson 1 (Lesson 2 not yet completed), manually construct/navigate to Lesson 3's route.
column4: Access is blocked (redirect back to the syllabus or an explicit locked message); Lesson 3 content is not rendered.
column15: Guards against URL-hacking per doc/specs/10-learning-management.md Technical Constraints.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Skipping or failing a Lesson's Quiz does not block unlocking the next Lesson.
column3: 1. Open a Lesson that has an attached Quiz. 2. Either skip the Quiz entirely or take it and answer incorrectly. 3. Tap "Mark as Completed" on the Lesson itself.
column4: The Lesson completes and the next Lesson unlocks regardless of the Quiz being skipped or failed - Quiz completion is explicitly not a gating condition (BR-LRN-02).
column5: A Lesson with an attached Quiz exists; Learner has reached it.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: My Learning's progress bar reflects completed-lessons / total-lessons accurately as the Learner advances.
column3: 1. Note the total Lesson count for a course. 2. Complete lessons one at a time, checking My Learning's progress % after each.
column4: The displayed percentage always equals (lessons completed so far / total lessons in the course version), updating immediately after each completion.
column5: Learner enrolled in a course with a known total Lesson count.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: " Continue Learning" resumes exactly at the Learner's last accessed/incomplete Lesson.
column3: 1. Complete a few lessons, then close/leave the app mid-course. 2. Reopen the app later and tap "Continue Learning" on that course from My Learning.
column4: The app opens directly to the first not-yet-completed Lesson (the one right after the last completed one), not back at Lesson 1.
column5: Learner has partially progressed through a course.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Completing the final Lesson brings the enrollment to 100% / COMPLETED.
column3: 1. Complete every remaining Lesson in the course, ending with the last one.
column4: Progress reaches 100%; the Enrollment's status becomes COMPLETED, which is what unlocks the ability to leave a Course Review (see SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC21).
column5: Learner is on the final incomplete Lesson of the course.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Learner takes a Lesson Quiz and sees per-question correctness and explanations after submitting.
column3: 1. Open a Lesson's attached Quiz. 2. Answer all questions. 3. Submit.
column4: The result screen shows the score plus, per question, whether the Learner's choice was correct and the explanation text.
column5: A Lesson with an attached Quiz exists.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Learner can retake the same Lesson Quiz and see prior attempts.
column3: 1. After submitting once (TC08), reopen the same Lesson Quiz and take it again with different answers.
column4: A new attempt is recorded without erasing the previous one; the Learner can review earlier attempt(s) if a history view is provided.
column5: A prior Quiz attempt exists from TC08.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Adding a Lesson in a newly published course version recalculates an enrolled Learner's progress percentage sanely.
column3: 1. As a Learner with partial progress in a course, wait for the Trainer to add a new Lesson and Publish a new version (SYS_FLOW_CRS_TC21-22), then switch to it (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC22). 2. Reopen My Learning.
column4: The progress percentage recalculates against the new total Lesson count (denominator increases); the value stays within 0-100% - it does not show an impossible number.
column5: A new course version with an added Lesson has been published and the Learner switched to it.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Removing a Lesson the Learner had already completed does not produce an out-of-bounds progress percentage.
column3: 1. As a Learner who completed a Lesson later removed in a new published version. 2. Switch to the new version and reopen My Learning.
column4: The recalculated percentage stays within 0-100% (never negative, never over 100%), consistent with the documented dynamic-recalculation edge case.
column5: A new version with a completed Lesson removed has been published and the Learner switched to it.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Course access remains available indefinitely after purchase/enrollment, with no expiry.
column3: 1. As a Learner enrolled well in the past (or simulate a long time gap since enrollment), open the course and any previously completed Lesson.
column4: All lesson content remains fully accessible; there is no expiry date/lock applied purely due to elapsed time (BR-LRN-05, lifetime access).
column5: An enrollment that is not recent exists.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Learner posts a question comment directly from the Lesson page while studying.
column3: 1. Open an unlocked Lesson. 2. Scroll to the comment section. 3. Enter a normal question and submit.
column4: The comment is submitted through the Rule Engine and, assuming clean text, appears immediately in the thread as APPROVED (full detail coverage in SYS_FLOW_CMT flow).
column5: Learner has access to the Lesson.
column15: See SYS_FLOW_CMT for the full moderation-outcome matrix (APPROVED/PENDING/REJECTED).

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: A Learner not enrolled in a paid course cannot open its Lesson detail content via a direct link.
column3: 1. As a Learner NOT enrolled in a specific paid course, obtain/guess a direct link to one of its Lessons. 2. Open it.
column4: Access is blocked or redirected to the course's purchase page; the actual Lesson content (text/video/quiz) is not rendered for a non-enrolled Learner.
column5: Learner is not enrolled in the target paid course.
column15: Cross-check against CRIT-02 in unit_test_plan.md/AUDIT_REPORT.md (userId param on complete/quiz endpoints not fully verified server-side) - if this UI-level guard passes but the raw API doesn't, note it as a gap needing the IT-level fix, not a System Test regression.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Marking a Lesson complete for a course the Learner is not enrolled in is rejected.
column3: 1. As a Learner not enrolled in a course, attempt to trigger "Mark as Completed" for one of its Lessons (e.g. via a stale cached screen or manipulated request).
column4: The action is rejected; no `lesson_progresses` row is created for a non-enrolled Learner; the course's enrollment/progress state for that user is unaffected.
column5: Learner is not enrolled in the target course.
column15: Same CRIT-02 cross-check as TC14 - report actual observed behavior even if it currently succeeds when it should not.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Full journey: enroll, progress sequentially through every Lesson, reach 100% completion, then leave a review.
column3: 1. Enroll in a course (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC03). 2. Complete every Lesson in order, taking each Quiz along the way. 3. Confirm the final Lesson completion brings the course to COMPLETED. 4. Leave a course review (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC21).
column4: Every stage transitions correctly; the Learner ends the journey at 100% progress, COMPLETED status, with a review successfully posted and reflected in the course's average rating.
column5: Fresh enrollment in a multi-lesson course.
column15: End-to-end smoke test tying together SYS_FLOW_ENR and SYS_FLOW_LRN.
